plugins.name: pstack-resident
plugins.description: Opt-in resident mode for pstack-zcode: a SessionStart hook that injects the condensed poteto-mode summary into sessions of projects where poteto-mode is installed. Installing this plugin is the whole opt-in; sessions in other projects get nothing.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 可选常驻模式：SessionStart 钩子向装有 poteto-mode 的项目注入精简纪律摘要，装插件即 opt-in。
